notes.title: 🎉 Don't FOOL Me, Beauties! — Official Launch! Time to Turn Up the Heat ♨️
notes.content:
Hello! This is the Dev team of <Don't FOOL ME, Beauties!>

Looking for something sweet, steamy, and just a little bit chaotic? ♨️
Get ready for flirty fun and mysterious moments at a hot spring filled with stunning beauties—
because Don't FOOL Me, Beauties! is officially live!

[h3]📅 Launch Date: July 7, 2025 (KST)[/h3]
📍 If you enjoyed the demo, the full version takes everything to the next level!

💖 Here’s what’s waiting for you:
🧖‍♀️ Romantic escapades with charming (and unpredictable) ladies
📷 Collect gorgeous reward photos that’ll make your heart skip a beat
🗳️ Vote for your favorite girl in live in-game events
🔁 30+ unique endings — your choices shape every twist and turn!

And the best part?
💫 It’s the perfect getaway... for less than the cost of a movie ticket.

[h3]🎮 Ready to fall head over heels?
▶ [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3516180/Dont_FOOL_ME_Beauties/][Play the FULL VERSION][/url]
▶ [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3678170/Dont_FOOL_ME_Beauties_Demo/][Try the DEMO][/url][/h3]

Think you can handle being outsmarted by these beauties (again)?
Then it’s time to check into Don't FOOL Me, Beauties! ♨️
